unverified_boundaries: Agent routing and interactive behavior have not been runtime-evaluated.
Scientific benchmarks, no-Skill comparisons and human-expert review are not performed.
Small helper execution does not establish representative study performance or biological validity.
One already-normalized log2 microarray platform, 20–30,000 probe/gene features, 4–32 independent samples, one contrast and at most one categorical adjustment.
Raw counts, TPM/FPKM, paired or longitudinal designs, probe collapsing, missing-value imputation and automatic normalization are excluded.
Only R 4.4.1 and limma 3.60.6 are supported by this initial adapter.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The assay, scale, independent units or normalization provenance is unresolved.
decision_sequence.question: 这些数值是否来自同一微阵列平台，并已经完成归一化及 log2 转换?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: 请提供处理方法和 sample_id、condition、subject_id 表；计数或 TPM 需要另一条分析路径。

runtime_verification.reason: Basic helper execution and input/hand-off checks are recorded separately; no agent or scientific benchmark claim.
